items.summary: Disposition: evidence_needed fleet-wide; blocked for public exposure and security-sensitive releases; conditional for ordinary bounded reversible growth. Concrete evidence: fleet-doctor has no run or control results; operations deploy-health, uptime, and error sweeps have no results; all 59 security sitefacts are unknown. Authentication and access boundaries, secrets handling, container isolation, release/deployment controls, dependency and supply-chain provenance, complete TLS posture, data exposure, monitoring, incident readiness, and security.txt/disclosure readiness remain unverified. Compliance is technical-only at 37 pass, 16 fail, and 6 unknown. No certificates are reported expiring within 30 days, but this does not establish complete TLS safety. No incident or exploitation is evidenced. Exact decision: preserve private launch gates and block security-sensitive releases; permit only reversible work that adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, new data collection, or cross-site behavior; continue the existing read-only security evidence matrix without duplicate telemetry or production changes.

Retain scaffold opportunities as preview-only and private. Do not queue implementation, deploy, publish, configure credentials or permissions, add dependencies, expand telemetry, or launch until owner, compliance, security, measurement, and rollback evidence is complete.
